company.shortDescription: Faggala.com is the 1st SaaS-enabled marketplace to connect customers with stationery retails.
company.description: Faggala.com is the 1st SaaS-enabled marketplace to digitalize the stationery value chain end to end by connecting customers with stationery retails. Faggala provides an Omni-Channel for Retailers to sell online & physically with instant stock sync While on the other side, the end-Customer saves cost, time and effort and gets the stationery orders on-demand shipped from the nearest retailer within 60 minutes. Faggala provides Real-time data-driven benchmarks, insights & forecasts. It is named for Faggala’s district, the most popular district in Egypt known for stationery products.
